[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-bp[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Day strip — a compact daily-stats receipt at the bottom of Bob [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]daily notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every canonical daily note (`YYYY/YYYYMMDD.md`) ends with a quiet, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beautiful Day strip of that day's own facts (Worked, Reviewed, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Done, Created, Review closed, and the area time mix). It is painted[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from cache in the first frame, re-runs `bob stats` only while it is[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on screen and the data has changed and aged, and is never written [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]into the note.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]daily_note_day_strip.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/daily_note_day_strip.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-bp[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-bp/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob stats reads "not yet" for an unmet provisional boolean[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]stats-not-yet[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stats-not-yet: in bob-cli, make an unmet provisional (today) boolean [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]point display `not yet` in JSON, CSV, and human output, and draw `◌` in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the bool sparkline. Then update the unit and CLI tests and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/stats.md display rules and M6 row.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stats fetch service fixes for the Stats page and the strip[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fetch-service[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fetch-service: in bob-plugins' bob-ledger-tools, give each key its own [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-flight promise behind a FIFO queue so no waiter is lost, track change[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]generations and fetch ages so cache hits spawn only when dirty, add a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cache-update listener API, a synchronous peek, and `group`. Also gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Stats page revalidation on visibility and add spawn counters.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Day strip model, painter, styles, and preview matrix[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]strip-view[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fetch-service[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]strip-view: add the pure `dayStripModel` and DOM `paintDayStrip`, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`.bob-day-strip` stylesheet, synthetic fixtures, model and painter [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests, and a headless-Chromium preview matrix. Inspect its screenshots [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]until the strip meets the visual contract.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Day strip data selection, refresh policy, fence, and Stats [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]hand-off[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]strip-hosts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fetch-service, strip-view[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]strip-hosts: add the day-identity and report-selection rules, the strip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]registry and its visible/dirty/aged refresh policy with rollover, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`bob-day-stats` fence host, and `openStatsForDay`, which opens Stats [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with the day pinned. Cover them with fake-timer, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fake-IntersectionObserver, and fake-execFile tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Virtual Live Preview mount, controls, and plugin docs[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]strip-mount[dim] · [dim][/dim]after strip-hosts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]strip-mount: mount the strip as a CodeMirror StateField block widget [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after the last line of canonical daily notes in Live Preview. Add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`stats.day_strip` config switch, the session `Toggle Day stats` command,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-device collapse, fence stand-down, and the optional Reading view [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]host. Then update plugin docs and the manifest, and sync to the vault.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Day strip contract in bob-cli docs and memory[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]strip-docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stats-not-yet, strip-mount[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]strip-docs: document the shipped Day strip in docs/stats.md (what it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shows, honest states, refresh budget, controls, fence) and link it from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/dashboard.md. Write the decision record and glossary term only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]where their memory decisions were accepted.[/#D7D7AF]
